comparison.objective: Lay a cable in a taped lane and pin it at three marks with sandbags; candidate finishes installed threaded inserts by breaking and collecting their tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Flexible-cable routing and weighted placement versus precision coaxial tool alignment, stabilized hammering, force regulation, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Cable straight in lane with bags on three marks and all objects released; candidate requires four physical fractures and complete safe containment without component damage.
comparison.reason: Cable restraint does not test impact-driven notch fracture or retention-sensitive fragment recovery. Numeric lane tolerances are absent but immaterial to the distinction.
